<solution_file path="src/t02_load_eurostat.py">
import pandas as pd
import os

def main():
    # Read selected indicators
    selected_indicators_path = "outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv"
    selected_df = pd.read_csv(selected_indicators_path)
    selected_ids = set(selected_df["indicator_id"].unique())

    # Read Eurostat city values sample
    eurostat_path = "inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv"
    eurostat_df = pd.read_csv(eurostat_path)

    # Filter to only selected indicators
    filtered_df = eurostat_df[eurostat_df["indicator_id"].isin(selected_ids)].copy()

    # Avoid duplicate city_id/year/indicator_id rows (keep first occurrence)
    filtered_df = filtered_df.drop_duplicates(subset=["city_id", "year", "indicator_id"], keep="first")

    # Select and order required columns
    output_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year", "indicator_id", "indicator_name", "value", "unit"]
    result_df = filtered_df[output_columns]

    # Sort for consistency
    result_df = result_df.sort_values(by=["city_id", "year", "indicator_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Ensure output directory exists
    os.makedirs("outputs", exist_ok=True)

    # Write RFC 4180 compliant CSV
    # quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL handles commas, quotes, newlines properly
    import csv
    output_path = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

    print(f"Wrote {len(result_df)} rows to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
